programme.title: 王者争霸 #7
programme.desc: 由亚马逊到安第斯山脉,南美洲有著一些美景。 从草原上吵闹的原驼,到滩头上挤拥的海鬣蜥,再到偷掉居所的寄居蟹,住屋的需求引发很多冲突。

programme.title: 野性汪洋 #7
programme.desc: ​马尔地夫面临前所未有的不确定命运,海平面持续上升,威胁将这座袖珍岛屿从世界地图抹除。观察科学研究人员如何努力重建岛屿周围的珊瑚礁,并同时展开拯救海龟的行动,同时揭示当地魔鬼𫚉隐秘而精妙的行为模式。

programme.title: 动物玩学志 #1
programme.desc: 在大自然中,年幼的动物大部分时间都在玩耍。从喜欢追逐的猫,到可以解决谜题的黑猩猩。新研究表明游戏几乎是动物学习的全部核心,它不仅是乐趣和游戏。

programme.title: 动物「洛」园 #1
programme.desc: 在山脉跨越国界的地方,麋鹿和驼鹿群与牠们的猎食者熊和狼等并存。猎食者和猎物的关系达致一种微妙的平衡,最理想的观赏场所是洛矶山脉的库特尼地区。

programme.title: 动物「洛」园 #2
programme.desc: 稀薄又寒冷的空气,连树木都无法生长 - 这不是一个怡人的居住地。但像山羊和大角羊,甚至黑熊这样的动物可以轻松地游走在这些山峰间。我们将看看牠们是如何在大陆最高峰之一的上面抵抗重力。

programme.title: 动物「洛」园 #3
programme.desc: 北美一些最宏伟的河流源于落矶山脉的冰川峭壁。落矶山脉的湖泊、河流和沼泽就像动脉一样在山脉中脉动,养育那些以山为家的生物。

programme.title: 动物「洛」园 #4
programme.desc: 在森林中生存意味著在生长和破坏,死亡和重生间保持微妙的平衡 - 森林应该处于一个持续再生的状态。当树木变得太高,它们会阻挡所有阳光照到地面上,这意味著小草和较小的灌木不能生长,减少了麋鹿、驼鹿、驯鹿和狼等动物的栖息地。

programme.title: 动物「洛」园 #5
programme.desc: 对许多物种而言,群体生活的结构对生存最为重要。虽然社会生活是许多以落矶山脉为家的动物不可或缺的,但没有两个物种以同样的方式组织牠们的社会。

programme.title: 深入印度 #5
programme.desc: 地球上最具代表性的动物之一 - 孟加拉虎在印度的丛林中徘徊。在一天的过程中,我们追随一位母亲和三只幼崽。 她必须为家人提供足够的食物来维持生计。

programme.title: 深入印度 #6
programme.desc: 当家庭分崩离析,一只幼狮必须活下来; 两只青少年豹崽在被遗弃后必须自生自灭,一只年轻的成年黑羚必须冒上生命和肢体的危险,因牠试图保证第一次交配。

programme.title: 深入印度 #7
programme.desc: 华赞是一头强大的雄性领袖,坐拥一个异常庞大的部队。他在维持这个大集团方面做得很好,但未来的路并不明朗。还有更多的同伴需要糊口,但牠的丛林正在萎缩。

programme.title: 深入印度 #8
programme.desc: 豪华的庙宇花园坐落在古城焦特布尔的边缘位置,是一大群长尾叶猴的家,牠们享受著宁静的生活,却有严格的等级制度。

programme.title: 深入印度 #9
programme.desc: 在印度南部炎热又潮湿的热带森林中,一位雌性眼镜王蛇正在执行任务: 在季候风到来前,她需要找到伴侣、食物并顺利下蛋。

programme.title: 野生守卫队 #1
programme.desc: 这是尚比亚两只黑犀牛的关键时刻。 四岁的雌性押臣和十四岁的公牛肯高是复杂的重置任务的核心,这是宏伟的拯救物种计划的一部分。

programme.title: 野生守卫队 #2
programme.desc: 在尚比亚最大和最野生的保护区卡富埃国家公园深处,来自「尚比亚肉食性动物计划」的生物学家和兽医团队争分夺秒地拯救和保护非洲的顶级掠食者。

programme.title: 颠沛流离亚马逊 #1
programme.desc: 亚马逊热带雨林中,拥有致命力量的掠食者正在捕猎。完美的进化 - 谁将获得胜利?

programme.title: 颠沛流离亚马逊 #2
programme.desc: 如同亚马逊的森林一样丰富,寻找爱情和养家一样是个挑战,交配策略也跟动物一样各适其适。

programme.title: 颠沛流离亚马逊 #3
programme.desc: 树木主导亚马逊地区,总数目超过三千亿。但是它们每一个都是独立又蓬勃发展的生态系统。它们是数十种不同动物所组成的繁忙社区。

programme.title: 颠沛流离亚马逊 #4
programme.desc: 在亚马逊森林中,情况可以瞬间从破裂的土地变为泛滥或被树木淹没。认识活在这个古老世界的物种必须如何足智多谋和有上进心,才能生存。

programme.title: 颠沛流离亚马逊 #5
programme.desc: 每年有20万只秘鲁猴子被非法贩运,大部分更是婴儿。猴子岛为贩卖、合法和非法狩猎的受害者提供第二次机会。我们记录了这些年轻猴子的生存困境。

programme.title: 野生守卫队 #1
programme.desc: 这是尚比亚两只黑犀牛的关键时刻。 四岁的雌性押臣和十四岁的公牛肯高是复杂的重置任务的核心,这是宏伟的拯救物种计划的一部分。

programme.title: 野生守卫队 #2
programme.desc: 在尚比亚最大和最野生的保护区卡富埃国家公园深处,来自「尚比亚肉食性动物计划」的生物学家和兽医团队争分夺秒地拯救和保护非洲的顶级掠食者。

programme.title: 颠沛流离亚马逊 #1
programme.desc: 亚马逊热带雨林中,拥有致命力量的掠食者正在捕猎。完美的进化 - 谁将获得胜利?

programme.title: 颠沛流离亚马逊 #2
programme.desc: 如同亚马逊的森林一样丰富,寻找爱情和养家一样是个挑战,交配策略也跟动物一样各适其适。

programme.title: 颠沛流离亚马逊 #3
programme.desc: 树木主导亚马逊地区,总数目超过三千亿。但是它们每一个都是独立又蓬勃发展的生态系统。它们是数十种不同动物所组成的繁忙社区。

programme.title: 颠沛流离亚马逊 #4
programme.desc: 在亚马逊森林中,情况可以瞬间从破裂的土地变为泛滥或被树木淹没。认识活在这个古老世界的物种必须如何足智多谋和有上进心,才能生存。

programme.title: 颠沛流离亚马逊 #5
programme.desc: 每年有20万只秘鲁猴子被非法贩运,大部分更是婴儿。猴子岛为贩卖、合法和非法狩猎的受害者提供第二次机会。我们记录了这些年轻猴子的生存困境。

programme.title: 王者争霸 #8
programme.desc: 现实中决斗的龙、巨型相扑甲虫、街头殴斗的猴子和扮演山之王的海龟- 处于另一只海龟之上,东南亚拥有繁多的野生动物战士。

programme.title: 野性汪洋 #8
programme.desc: 哥斯达黎加的太平洋沿岸是一个生物多样性热点,拥有著近5000种海洋生物。但在这片海底森林中,海洋王者- 鲨鱼因丧失栖息地和过捕而面临著生命威胁。哥斯达黎加热情的海洋防衞者现正联手为这些濒临绝种的生物创造一个更安全的家园,并使牠们免于灭绝。

programme.title: 动物玩学志 #2
programme.desc: 世界各地的动物会玩各种团体游戏,从玩扯大缆的年轻鬣狗,到喜欢混战的淘气猴子。但为甚么有些动物需要跟同伴一起玩耍呢?游戏的规则又是甚么呢?

programme.title: 非洲视「野」 #1
programme.desc: 南非的塞德堡山脉是一片多年来由风、水和火雕琢而成的奇石地貌。这些壮观的山峰是众多不同植物和动物的家。但这里亦有些看不见的东西,垫伏在阴暗处伺机攻击。

programme.title: 非洲视「野」 #2
programme.desc: 纳米比沙漠是最极端的地方,由冰洋到黄沙,需要惊人的坚韧和适应力才能生存,只有特别存在的少数能做到。由响尾蝰蛇到纳米比沙漠甲虫,每种动物都为求存而各显神通。

programme.title: 非洲视「野」 #3
programme.desc: 纳米比沙漠是世上最古老的沙漠,拥有超过400公里的非洲海岸线,也是地球上最荒凉的栖息地之一。但世界上最大的陆地哺乳类竟然在这里扎根,透过改变行为来适应极端的生活。

programme.title: 非洲视「野」 #4
programme.desc: 在南非海岸的岩石岛屿上,成千上万的动物聚首等待繁殖。其中,巨大的开普塘鹅群占大多数。被丰富的水资源环绕,牠们可以找到足够的食物来养活自己和幼鹅,但牠们的生命仍然充满挑战。

programme.title: 非洲视「野」 #5
programme.desc: 东开普省正在致力投资生态旅游和保育,以替代捕鱼和商业开发。该处为了野生生态正在开垦农田,关闭渔场。这是最令人兴奋的非洲保育成功故事之一。

programme.title: 饥饿游戏: 阿拉斯加的大熊挑战 #2
programme.desc: 与初赛的优胜者和一些强悍的新挑战者一起投入这场疯狂的冲刺,迎接他们的在七月洄游的鲑鱼!跟随大男孩踏上寻找美食之旅,并欢迎红背儿参加盛宴;再看看新手妈妈能否保护她仅存的小熊。

programme.title: 饥饿游戏: 阿拉斯加的大熊挑战 #3
programme.desc: 挑战者一一提起精神,因为十月的寒流使局面变得更加复杂。看看大男孩在绊倒后如何重新振作,然后见证悲剧降临四子之母。为粉丝最爱的新手妈妈和她的黏人的小孩加油。挑战来到尾声,谁会成为最终的皇者?

programme.title: 尚比亚野生故事 #1
programme.desc: 在这片小林地中,两只幼猴面临一生中最艰难的日子。牠们要在世上找到一席之地时,必须了解哪些邻居是盟友,哪些是敌人;谁值得信赖,谁应该避开。牠们会失去或得到朋友,这样才算是林地的一份子。

programme.title: 尚比亚野生故事 #2
programme.desc: 尚比亚的荒野是一个难以生存的地方。这里许多动物都必须成群结队来帮忙保卫领土、保护后代、觅食和对抗掠食者。

programme.title: 尚比亚野生故事 #3
programme.desc: 每天在卢安瓜谷都会看到一具动物尸体。每一具都拥有导致牠们死亡的故事。在草原狩猎鉴证科中,我们调查已发现的3具尸体的死亡个案

programme.title: 海滩「龟」来记
programme.desc: 当成千上万的海龟日以继夜登上哥斯达黎加的海滩生下数以百万计的蛋,当地人称之为「到达」。本节目满是新发现,加拿大自然学家及摄影师胡戈基奇跟随一队国际科学家团队进行创新性的科学考察,以解开这个稀有现象的谜底。

programme.title: 宁格鲁: 澳大利亚的海洋奇观 #1
programme.desc: 与蒂姆、当地土著和其他专家一同观察塑造宁格鲁珊瑚礁、开普山脉和埃克斯茅斯湾的自然与人为力量。欣赏有百万年历史的珊瑚礁化石、一条巨大的鱼和令人震撼的鳐鱼。

programme.title: 宁格鲁: 澳大利亚的海洋奇观 #2
programme.desc: 跟随科学家和当地土著一起规划保护宁格鲁生物多样性的生态联系、迁徙途径和物种纽带。与鲸鱼嬉戏,在海藻岛之间漂浮,见证考古学家揭穿定居者的神话。

programme.title: 宁格鲁: 澳大利亚的海洋奇观 #3
programme.desc: 了解宁格鲁的保护性奇迹如何激励人类帮助地球摆脱气候破坏的影响。参观废弃的捕鲸站与其他遗迹,这些都表明只要我们拥有改变的决心,我们就会有改变的工具。

programme.title: 深渊异形 #1
programme.desc: 熟悉各种海洋怪咖,从冰河时期到小行星撞击,了解数���亿年来的变化,如何塑造牠们的外表和技能。认识会钓鱼的蛇蜥、跑行的鲨鱼、爬树的螃蟹等。

programme.title: 深渊异形 #2
programme.desc: 感受地球上一些最奇特的怪胎伙伴关系中古怪而温馨的爱。深入观察奇怪的动物,从鼓虾到鳗狼鱼,向牠们的海洋怪人朋友伸出援手,以确保能一起生存下来。

programme.title: 深渊异形 #3
programme.desc: 引导你骨子里的科幻迷,探索海洋中最奇特生物的奇异交配仪式。了解为交配而战、性别偏移和一班加大码婴儿为了下一代能有多血腥。

programme.title: 王者争霸 #6
programme.desc: 加拿大的夏季短捉,时间紧迫- 任何时候都是战斗的好时机。宏大的北方为野牛、秃鹰和北极熊提供了动物王国中激战的战场。

programme.title: 熊宝贝训练营 #5
programme.desc: 窥探小熊们在夏季如何学习爬树和觅食,为重返野外生活做好准备。迎接一批新成员惊喜入营,见证熊宝贝们进入冬眠前的大吃特吃,并享受一场盛大的小熊感恩祭。

programme.title: 熊宝贝训练营 #6
programme.desc: 跟随罗杰为夏季小熊的野放做好准备,然后一起认识两位新来的小熊——艾斯和小蓝莓;牠们因严重的健康问题,必须在营中暂住,与新一批小熊们一起过冬。最后,一同庆祝六只健康快乐的熊宝贝踏上全新的野外生活。

programme.title: 野生动物如何睡觉
programme.desc: 动物之间的睡眠策略千变万化,然而睡眠似乎是一种再普遍不过的行为。但究竟为何动物需要睡眠呢?它们如何应对无法休息或在野外昏迷可能带来的危险?这些问题只是《野生动物如何睡觉》中的冰山一角。

programme.title: 13小时生还记 #1
programme.desc: 深入潮池世界,旁观寄居蟹四处觅屋,小猫鲨遇见奇怪的邻居,并见证章鱼化身猎食者,令猎物闻风丧胆。在灼热的日光下,池中氧气逐渐耗尽,海鸥也看准时机,在水面上大快朵颐。

programme.title: 13小时生还记 #2
programme.desc: 夕阳西下,掠食者在潮池边伺机行动,只待潮水再度涌来。夜幕低垂,一只爱偷窃的海蛞蝓与懂得翻腾两周半的扇贝奋力求生;一对狡猾的螃蟹则挺而走险,展开一场充满挑战的求爱任务。

programme.title: 深入印度 #9
programme.desc: 在印度南部炎热又潮湿的热带森林中,一位雌性眼镜王蛇正在执行任务: 在季候风到来前,她需要找到伴侣、食物并顺利下蛋。

programme.title: 大战狐?岛 #5
programme.desc: 贝伦地保育区的环尾狐猴过得动荡不安,族群急忙利用早前降雨后的短暂大餐,因为随之而来又是干燥日子。随著牠们的幼崽长大,觅食的压力变得比之前更大。

programme.desc: 跟随罗杰为夏季小熊的野放做好准备,然后一起认识两位新来的小熊——艾斯和小蓝莓;牠们因严重的健康问题,必须在营中暂住,与新一批小熊们一起过冬。最后,一同庆祝六只健康快乐的熊宝贝踏上全新的野外生活。

programme.title: 大战狐?岛 #5
programme.desc: 贝伦地保育区的环尾狐猴过得动荡不安,族群急忙利用早前降雨后的短暂大餐,因为随之而来又是干燥日子。随著牠们的幼崽长大,觅食的压力变得比之前更大。

programme.title: 13小时生还记 #1
programme.desc: 深入潮池世界,旁观寄居蟹四处觅屋,小猫鲨遇见奇怪的邻居,并见证章鱼化身猎食者,令猎物闻风丧胆。在灼热的日光下,池中氧气逐渐耗尽,海鸥也看准时机,在水面上大快朵颐。

programme.title: 13小时生还记 #2
programme.desc: 夕阳西下,掠食者在潮池边伺机行动,只待潮水再度涌来。夜幕低垂,一只爱偷窃的海蛞蝓与懂得翻腾两周半的扇贝奋力求生;一对狡猾的螃蟹则挺而走险,展开一场充满挑战的求爱任务。

programme.title: 王者争霸 #7
programme.desc: 由亚马逊到安第斯山脉,南美洲有著一些美景。 从草原上吵闹的原驼,到滩头上挤拥的海鬣蜥,再到偷掉居所的寄居蟹,住屋的需求引发很多冲突。

programme.title: 野性汪洋 #7
programme.desc: ​马尔地夫面临前所未有的不确定命运,海平面持续上升,威胁将这座袖珍岛屿从世界地图抹除。观察科学研究人员如何努力重建岛屿周围的珊瑚礁,并同时展开拯救海龟的行动,同时揭示当地魔鬼𫚉隐秘而精妙的行为模式。

programme.title: 动物玩学志 #1
programme.desc: 在大自然中,年幼的动物大部分时间都在玩耍。从喜欢追逐的猫,到可以解决谜题的黑猩猩。新研究表明游戏几乎是动物学习的全部核心,它不仅是乐趣和游戏。

programme.title: 动物「洛」园 #1
programme.desc: 在山脉跨越国界的地方,麋鹿和驼鹿群与牠们的猎食者熊和狼等并存。猎食者和猎物的关系达致一种微妙的平衡,最理想的观赏场所是洛矶山脉的库特尼地区。

programme.title: 动物「洛」园 #2
programme.desc: 稀薄又寒冷的空气,连树木都无法生长 - 这不是一个怡人的居住地。但像山羊和大角羊,甚至黑熊这样的动物可以轻松地游走在这些山峰间。我们将看看牠们是如何在大陆最高峰之一的上面抵抗重力。

programme.title: 动物「洛」园 #3
programme.desc: 北美一些最宏伟的河流源于落矶山脉的冰川峭壁。落矶山脉的湖泊、河流和沼泽就像动脉一样在山脉中脉动,养育那些以山为家的生物。

programme.title: 动物「洛」园 #4
programme.desc: 在森林中生存意味著在生长和破坏,死亡和重生间保持微妙的平衡 - 森林应该处于一个持续再生的状态。当树木变得太高,它们会阻挡所有阳光照到地面上,这意味著小草和较小的灌木不能生长,减少了麋鹿、驼鹿、驯鹿和狼等动物的栖息地。

programme.title: 动物「洛」园 #5
programme.desc: 对许多物种而言,群体生活的结构对生存最为重要。虽然社会生活是许多以落矶山脉为家的动物不可或缺的,但没有两个物种以同样的方式组织牠们的社会。

programme.title: 深入印度 #5
programme.desc: 地球上最具代表性的动物之一 - 孟加拉虎在印度的丛林中徘徊。在一天的过程中,我们追随一位母亲和三只幼崽。 她必须为家人提供足够的食物来维持生计。

programme.title: 深入印度 #6
programme.desc: 当家庭分崩离析,一只幼狮必须活下来; 两只青少年豹崽在被遗弃后必须自生自灭,一只年轻的成年黑羚必须冒上生命和肢体的危险,因牠试图保证第一次交配。

programme.title: 深入印度 #7
programme.desc: 华赞是一头强大的雄性领袖,坐拥一个异常庞大的部队。他在维持这个大集团方面做得很好,但未来的路并不明朗。还有更多的同伴需要糊口,但牠的丛林正在萎缩。

programme.title: 深入印度 #8
programme.desc: 豪华的庙宇花园坐落在古城焦特布尔的边缘位置,是一大群长尾叶猴的家,牠们享受著宁静的生活,却有严格的等级制度。

programme.title: 深入印度 #9
programme.desc: 在印度南部炎热又潮湿的热带森林中,一位雌性眼镜王蛇正在执行任务: 在季候风到来前,她需要找到伴侣、食物并顺利下蛋。

programme.title: 野生守卫队 #1
programme.desc: 这是尚比亚两只黑犀牛的关键时刻。 四岁的雌性押臣和十四岁的公牛肯高是复杂的重置任务的核心,这是宏伟的拯救物种计划的一部分。

programme.title: 野生守卫队 #2
programme.desc: 在尚比亚最大和最野生的保护区卡富埃国家公园深处,来自「尚比亚肉食性动物计划」的生物学家和兽医团队争分夺秒地拯救和保护非洲的顶级掠食者。

programme.title: 颠沛流离亚马逊 #1
programme.desc: 亚马逊热带雨林中,拥有致命力量的掠食者正在捕猎。完美的进化 - 谁将获得胜利?

programme.title: 颠沛流离亚马逊 #2
programme.desc: 如同亚马逊的森林一样丰富,寻找爱情和养家一样是个挑战,交配策略也跟动物一样各适其适。

programme.title: 颠沛流离亚马逊 #3
programme.desc: 树木主导亚马逊地区,总数目超过三千亿。但是它们每一个都是独立又蓬勃发展的生态系统。它们是数十种不同动物所组成的繁忙社区。

programme.title: 颠沛流离亚马逊 #4
programme.desc: 在亚马逊森林中,情况可以瞬间从破裂的土地变为泛滥或被树木淹没。认识活在这个古老世界的物种必须如何足智多谋和有上进心,才能生存。

programme.title: 颠沛流离亚马逊 #5
programme.desc: 每年有20万只秘鲁猴子被非法贩运,大部分更是婴儿。猴子岛为贩卖、合法和非法狩猎的受害者提供第二次机会。我们记录了这些年轻猴子的生存困境。

programme.title: 野生守卫队 #1

programme.title: 王者争霸 #8
programme.desc: 现实中决斗的龙、巨型相扑甲虫、街头殴斗的猴子和扮演山之王的海龟- 处于另一只海龟之上,东南亚拥有繁多的野生动物战士。

programme.title: 野性汪洋 #8
programme.desc: 哥斯达黎加的太平洋沿岸是一个生物多样性热点,拥有著近5000种海洋生物。但在这片海底森林中,海洋王者- 鲨鱼因丧失栖息地和过捕而面临著生命威胁。哥斯达黎加热情的海洋防衞者现正联手为这些濒临绝种的生物创造一个更安全的家园,并使牠们免于灭绝。

programme.title: 动物玩学志 #2
programme.desc: 世界各地的动物会玩各种团体游戏,从玩扯大缆的年轻鬣狗,到喜欢混战的淘气猴子。但为甚么有些动物需要跟同伴一起玩耍呢?游戏的规则又是甚么呢?

programme.title: 非洲视「野」 #1
programme.desc: 南非的塞德堡山脉是一片多年来由风、水和火雕琢而成的奇石地貌。这些壮观的山峰是众多不同植物和动物的家。但这里亦有些看不见的东西,垫伏在阴暗处伺机攻击。

programme.title: 非洲视「野」 #2
programme.desc: 纳米比沙漠是最极端的地方,由冰洋到黄沙,需要惊人的坚韧和适应力才能生存,只有特别存在的少数能做到。由响尾蝰蛇到纳米比沙漠甲虫,每种动物都为求存而各显神通。

programme.title: 非洲视「野」 #3
programme.desc: 纳米比沙漠是世上最古老的沙漠,拥有超过400公里的非洲海岸线,也是地球上最荒凉的栖息地之一。但世界上最大的陆地哺乳类竟然在这里扎根,透过改变行为来适应极端的生活。

programme.title: 非洲视「野」 #4
programme.desc: 在南非海岸的岩石岛屿上,成千上万的动物聚首等待繁殖。其中,巨大的开普塘鹅群占大多数。被丰富的水资源环绕,牠们可以找到足够的食物来养活自己和幼鹅,但牠们的生命仍然充满挑战。

programme.title: 非洲视「野」 #5
programme.desc: 东开普省正在致力投资生态旅游和保育,以替代捕鱼和商业开发。该处为了野生生态正在开垦农田,关闭渔场。这是最令人兴奋的非洲保育成功故事之一。

programme.title: 饥饿游戏: 阿拉斯加的大熊挑战 #2
programme.desc: 与初赛的优胜者和一些强悍的新挑战者一起投入这场疯狂的冲刺,迎接他们的在七月洄游的鲑鱼!跟随大男孩踏上寻找美食之旅,并欢迎红背儿参加盛宴;再看看新手妈妈能否保护她仅存的小熊。

programme.title: 饥饿游戏: 阿拉斯加的大熊挑战 #3
programme.desc: 挑战者一一提起精神,因为十月的寒流使局面变得更加复杂。看看大男孩在绊倒后如何重新振作,然后见证悲剧降临四子之母。为粉丝最爱的新手妈妈和她的黏人的小孩加油。挑战来到尾声,谁会成为最终的皇者?

programme.title: 尚比亚野生故事 #1
programme.desc: 在这片小林地中,两只幼猴面临一生中最艰难的日子。牠们要在世上找到一席之地时,必须了解哪些邻居是盟友,哪些是敌人;谁值得信赖,谁应该避开。牠们会失去或得到朋友,这样才算是林地的一份子。

programme.title: 尚比亚野生故事 #2
programme.desc: 尚比亚的荒野是一个难以生存的地方。这里许多动物都必须成群结队来帮忙保卫领土、保护后代、觅食和对抗掠食者。

programme.title: 尚比亚野生故事 #3
programme.desc: 每天在卢安瓜谷都会看到一具动物尸体。每一具都拥有导致牠们死亡的故事。在草原狩猎鉴证科中,我们调查已发现的3具尸体的死亡个案

programme.title: 海滩「龟」来记
programme.desc: 当成千上万的海龟日以继夜登上哥斯达黎加的海滩生下数以百万计的蛋,当地人称之为「到达」。本节目满是新发现,加拿大自然学家及摄影师胡戈基奇跟随一队国际科学家团队进行创新性的科学考察,以解开这个稀有现象的谜底。

programme.title: 宁格鲁: 澳大利亚的海洋奇观 #1
programme.desc: 与蒂姆、当地土著和其他专家一同观察塑造宁格鲁珊瑚礁、开普山脉和埃克斯茅斯湾的自然与人为力量。欣赏有百万年历史的珊瑚礁化石、一条巨大的鱼和令人震撼的鳐鱼。

programme.title: 宁格鲁: 澳大利亚的海洋奇观 #2
programme.desc: 跟随科学家和当地土著一起规划保护宁格鲁生物多样性的生态联系、迁徙途径和物种纽带。与鲸鱼嬉戏,在海藻岛之间漂浮,见证考古学家揭穿定居者的神话。

programme.title: 宁格鲁: 澳大利亚的海洋奇观 #3
programme.desc: 了解宁格鲁的保护性奇迹如何激励人类帮助地球摆脱气候破坏的影响。参观废弃的捕鲸站与其他遗迹,这些都表明只要我们拥有改变的决心,我们就会有改变的工具。

programme.title: 深渊异形 #1
programme.desc: 熟悉各种海洋怪咖,从冰河时期到小行星撞击,了解数���亿年来的变化,如何塑造牠们的外表和技能。认识会钓鱼的蛇蜥、跑行的鲨鱼、爬树的螃蟹等。

programme.title: 深渊异形 #2
programme.desc: 感受地球上一些最奇特的怪胎伙伴关系中古怪而温馨的爱。深入观察奇怪的动物,从鼓虾到鳗狼鱼,向牠们的海洋怪人朋友伸出援手,以确保能一起生存下来。

programme.title: 深渊异形 #3
programme.desc: 引导你骨子里的科幻迷,探索海洋中最奇特生物的奇异交配仪式。了解为交配而战、性别偏移和一班加大码婴儿为了下一代能有多血腥。

programme.title: 起司爱旅 #1
programme.desc: 起司大师阿弗林・普里斯汀的起司探险之旅从阿尔卑斯山国瑞士展开,这里是格鲁耶尔与经典孔洞艾门塔起司的故乡。

programme.title: 起司爱旅 #2

programme.title: Have A Pet Day
programme.desc: Renowned Golden Bell awarded host Sandy Wu takes her beloved dog Hershey on outings, inviting celebrities and their adorable pets to join in the fun Beyond exploring nature, the show delves into heartfelt conversations about the journey of pet ownership and shares touching stories amid delightful scenery and cuisine The program features various enjoyable activities where owners and pets can bond, creating unforgettable memories through laughter and tears

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In this special edition of the Dog Rescuers we go to Hong Kong The RSPCA doesn't just look after the welfare of dogs here in the UK, but also collaborates with parts of Europe, Asia and Africa In Hong Kong they've been working closely with local SPCA as they try to combat their ever growing stray dog population As part of an exchange programme with the UK that has been running for over a decade, Inspector Herchy Boal has come to witness and learn about those problems first hand so the two charities can work together on future solutions

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.desc: 海军犯罪调查局调查嘉倩的一名法医学家中毒身亡案。另外,麦之就其书中的内容接受五角大楼的盘问。

programme.title: 恐怖鸟
programme.desc: 麦迪和她的大学朋友们走进荒野寻找她的父亲,但他们却遇到了一度被认为已经灭绝的猛禽。

programme.title: 侏罗纪公园
programme.desc: 一位工业家邀请一些专家参观他的复制恐龙主题乐园。一场停电让这些生物逃了出来,危及所有人的性命,当中还包括他的孙儿。

programme.title: 魔鬼克星

programme.title: 回到未来 III
programme.desc: 在《回到未来 III》中,马蒂穿越回1885年,从亡命之徒手中救了博士。这部影片充满了笑话、动作和感人肺腑的剧情,是这部备受喜爱的三部曲史诗般的西部大结局。

programme.title: 海贼王女 #1
programme.desc: 在幽暗月光的映照下,有艘船在海上被赤红火焰吞噬……年幼的菲娜在雪丸的帮助下脱险,孤独地漂流到「香格里拉」。10年后她成长为被称作岸边白花的美丽少女。菲娜忘不了在小时候救了自己的雪丸,于是在迎来初夜之际打算趁乱逃出这座岛。

programme.title: 海贼王女 #2
programme.desc: 菲娜醒来时发现自己乘坐在漂浮于大西洋的小船中。帮助她逃离岛屿的是侍奉于霍特曼家的骑士奥托与萨尔曼,两人接著将她带到被雾气围绕的「哥布林岛」。菲娜在此遇见佛兰兹的老友幸久,幸久请她解开父亲留下的石头谜团。

programme.title: 海贼王女 #3
programme.desc: 菲娜决定代替父亲踏上尚未结束的旅程,与雪丸一行人从哥布林岛启程。众人为了做足准备,停靠自由都市巴尔巴拉尔 。菲娜找到一件商品,酷似父亲遗留的石头。但此时追兵却上前阻挠。

programme.title: 海贼王女 #4
programme.desc: 从追兵手下脱逃的菲娜一行人前往石头的制造地「利巴尔奥伯施泰因」。菲娜害雪丸受伤后对此感到懊悔。她向伙伴商量,希望他们能教授战斗方式。武士们一开始拒绝这项提议,但渐渐被她想帮雪丸的心意感化……

programme.title: 海贼王 #25
programme.desc: 为了营救艾斯,白胡子海贼团与海军本部、七武海在马林福特爆发激战,而鲁夫也率领越狱犯加入战场。鲁夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯却为了保护他而被赤犬击杀,白胡子亦战死。战争最终在红发杰克的介入下落幕。经此一战,鲁夫与伙伴们决定分别修行两年后再会。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第三季) #3
programme.desc: 天童觉原本一副懒散的样子,却突然开始认真。可以预测球路的他,靠著拦网得了好多分。白鸟泽有主攻手牛岛跟预测天才的天童,让乌野的情势更加严峻。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第三季) #4
programme.desc: 第二局打到局末点之后,乌野跟白鸟泽开始磨人的拉锯战,双方互不相让。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第三季) #5
programme.desc: 月岛终于在百般计算之后等到机会,成功拦下牛岛的杀球。这时候被牛岛刺激到的日向,终于开始发挥他在前线的机动性,拦网跟进攻兼顾,让白鸟泽一时无法反应。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第三季) #6
programme.desc: 在山口、月岛、西谷等人发挥实力的情况下,乌野努力跟白鸟泽纠缠著进入平局抢分。

programme.title: 排球少年!! (第三季) #7
programme.desc: 乌野高中对白鸟泽学园的激战终于来到了最后一局。此时不断拦网牛岛的月岛却发生了意外退场,在关键时刻失去重要球员的乌野 。

programme.title: 家里蹲吸血姬的郁闷 #1
programme.desc: 黛拉可玛莉岗德森布莱德诞生在姆尔纳特帝国贵族世家,却天天享受家里蹲生活。某天,薇儿海丝出现在她面前,自称是她的专属女仆并告知可玛莉已经被任命为「七红天大将军」。七红天的必备条件是强大的实力,但可玛莉是个身为吸血鬼却喝不了血的娇弱少女。

programme.title: 家里蹲吸血姬的郁闷 #2
programme.desc: 可玛莉突然被任命为七红天,仍然靠运气与虚张声势,漂亮地击退了想要以下犯上的部下,初次征战也夺下胜利,还顺利与一群怪人部下开完会,也获得了骑兽,心情非常愉悦。而部下约翰却突然提出决斗。在众目睽睽之下,可玛莉该如何在决斗展现七红天的威严?

programme.title: 家里蹲吸血姬的郁闷 #3
programme.desc: 透过薇儿的策略,可玛莉将约翰打得体无完肤。因此在部下之间掀起可玛莉旋风,与他国的战争也是百战百胜。但是在庆功宴出现了一名少女。她的名字是米莉桑德,过去与可玛莉曾结下各种恩怨。米莉桑德突然袭击,让可玛莉完全反应不过来……

programme.title: 家里蹲吸血姬的郁闷 #4
programme.desc: 为了救出遭掳的薇儿,可玛莉独自去见米莉桑德。面对可玛莉,米莉桑德开始讲起三年前发生在学院的那起事件的真相。可玛莉听到米莉桑德充满憎恶与杀意的话语,她下定决心战斗。三年前就读同一间学院,却踏上截然不同的道路的两人,如今将再次交锋!

programme.title: 和山田谈场LV999的恋爱 #7
programme.desc: 为了修理茜的电脑,山田来到了她的公寓。一直以来因某些原因而刻意与女性保持距离的山田,不知为何无法将视线从午睡中的茜身上移开。就在他忍不住伸手想触碰茜的头发时,玄关的门铃突然响起。出现在门口的竟是茜的前男友拓马,对方也对山田的存在感到诧异。

programme.title: 和山田谈场LV999的恋爱 #8
programme.desc: 茜和公会成员们来到山田就读高中的学园祭「东成祭」。瑛太和鸭田去了由学生们经营的女仆咖啡厅,琉奈则因明年将面对这所学校入学考的压力而突然肚子痛,冲进洗手间。茜和山田决定先去购物,山田与女性在校园内同行的稀奇景象,引起周围学生与教师的议论。

programme.title: 和山田谈场LV999的恋爱 #9
programme.desc: 在学园祭上茜和山田坦诚地交流了心中的感受,变得比以前更加亲近。虽然茜已经意识到自己对山田的感情,但仍对这位比自己年轻的高中生有所保留。在这股矛盾和不安的情绪中,FOS的公会有位女性新成员加入,而让茜感到惊讶的是对方竟是山田的同班同学。

programme.title: 成为名留青史的坏女人吧 #1
programme.desc: 威廉斯艾莉西亚在7岁的某天早晨突然惊觉,「我现在在前世玩的女性向游戏世界里!」。当她发现自己就是前世所向往的反派千金后,她决定―― 「我,要成为名留历史的坏女人!」

programme.title: 成为名留青史的坏女人吧 #2
programme.desc: 为了成为名留历史的坏女人,艾莉西亚每日勤奋不懈,不仅努力追求知识,也重视在实地的亲见亲闻,她因而前往被魔法隔离的罗亚纳村。没想到在当地等著她的是足以左右她人生的一场相遇!

programme.desc: 监志哭著拜托守仁。原因是他一下就将家里送来的钱花光,付不出给乙木家的生活费。于是守仁将曙乃游乐园英雄秀的打工招募传单递给了监志。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #9
programme.desc: 同班同学伽罗拜托妮可「复原被碎纸机碎掉的纸屑」。然而,妮可的修复魔法「魔女恢复」必须在目标物处于完整一堆的状态才有效果,现在混合了各种不同的纸屑是无法使用的。伽罗表示,她想复原的是过世的母亲寄给她的信。而将那封信丢入碎纸机的人正是她爸爸。

programme.desc: 守仁被一群「老套」人物组成的学生会盯上了。性感系大姊姊副会长伊武荆、关西系瞇瞇眼温柔男副会长剑持弓弦、双胞胎姊妹书记、天才骇客会计、野兽系无脑巨汉宣传、精神异常系舔刀哥总务、同为总务的神秘机器人,以及右手按在帽子上不放的学生会长清宫天流。

programme.desc: 茜和公会成员们来到山田就读高中的学园祭「东成祭」。瑛太和鸭田去了由学生们经营的女仆咖啡厅,琉奈则因明年将面对这所学校入学考的压力而突然肚子痛,冲进洗手间。茜和山田决定先去购物,山田与女性在校园内同行的稀奇景象,引起周围学生与教师的议论。

programme.title: 和山田谈场LV999的恋爱 #9
programme.desc: 在学园祭上茜和山田坦诚地交流了心中的感受,变得比以前更加亲近。虽然茜已经意识到自己对山田的感情,但仍对这位比自己年轻的高中生有所保留。在这股矛盾和不安的情绪中,FOS的公会有位女性新成员加入,而让茜感到惊讶的是对方竟是山田的同班同学。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #7
programme.desc: 妮可和监志因为「好像能赚钱」这个理由而开设了上传影片的频道「监妮可频道」。而守仁对于妮可和监志上传的影片品味之差感到火大,于是向班上的同学,次文化混蛋真神圭护寻求建议。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #8
programme.desc: 监志哭著拜托守仁。原因是他一下就将家里送来的钱花光,付不出给乙木家的生活费。于是守仁将曙乃游乐园英雄秀的打工招募传单递给了监志。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #9
programme.desc: 同班同学伽罗拜托妮可「复原被碎纸机碎掉的纸屑」。然而,妮可的修复魔法「魔女恢复」必须在目标物处于完整一堆的状态才有效果,现在混合了各种不同的纸屑是无法使用的。伽罗表示,她想复原的是过世的母亲寄给她的信。而将那封信丢入碎纸机的人正是她爸爸。

programme.title: WITCH WATCH 魔女守护者 #10
programme.desc: 守仁被一群「老套」人物组成的学生会盯上了。性感系大姊姊副会长伊武荆、关西系瞇瞇眼温柔男副会长剑持弓弦、双胞胎姊妹书记、天才骇客会计、野兽系无脑巨汉宣传、精神异常系舔刀哥总务、同为总务的神秘机器人,以及右手按在帽子上不放的学生会长清宫天流。

programme.title: 王一平牧师-一言道破

programme.title: 世界生命之道:邝保亮牧师
programme.desc: 邝保亮牧师,与父亲邝健雄牧师一同于新加坡带领9千多人的教会,承传父亲热心布道的精神,继续以激励人心的资讯,挑战我们成为为主摆上的门徒!

programme.title: 圣经实战攻略

programme.title: 来!为这城祷告

programme.title: 香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
香港早晨粤 及 非法外围大追击2026粤
高朋满座#63粤
programme.desc: 朋坚持要送婷留学，婷绝食抗议，朋连厨艺也下降。家人推举悦解决此事，悦成功让婷在众人前签下「独立合约」，婷亦真的修心养性，朋亦动摇他要婷留学的决心。可惜，婷足球队的队友突然对她有求，令她被迫说谎。

programme.title: 尚食#3粤普
programme.desc: 庖厨战战兢兢地给太子做菜，太子对菜式点头称赞；庖厨回去时，一帆检查太子吃剩的菜式是否有肉；紫萍担心自己冒名顶替会被锦衣卫发现；太子对汉王上书赈灾查证一事很气愤，瞻基提醒太子不要急于觐见，需要从长计议。

programme.title: 交易现场粤 及 潮流生活志粤
阿爷厨房粤
programme.desc: 「鼎爷」李家鼎再次开炉，奉上连串「消失的味道」。首集公开「古法阿爷虾抽」秘方，腌制前要烘熟虾只并剪开虾背，有助提升鲜味。用镬炮制烧肉方便快捷，要做出「荔枝皮」有何技巧？「镬底烧肉」配以虾抽一起享用，鲜甜香脆！鼎爷带拍档「阿谭」谭玉瑛到西瓜田，分享拣选「美人」的要诀。未熟的西瓜亦有用处？阿谭心急试吃「西瓜酸」，却瞬间变脸！鼎爷提醒烹调西瓜酸前须汆水减咸，再加糖调味，并带来惹味菜式「西瓜酸炒牛柳」。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 急性喉炎常见于转季时，患者多会出现声沙、喉咙痛等症状。耳鼻喉专科医生提醒，婴幼儿因上呼吸道较狭窄，如出现呼吸困难或喘鸣声，应马上求医。急性喉炎亦可能引致扁桃腺炎等并发症，治疗详情如何？有设计师因疫情契机转型全职艺术家，可曾为生计忧心？他希望透过以马为主题的创作，展现自由、勇往直前的精神。他又细谈画马的难处，并述说创作平面画与立体画的差异。「睇𩠌食饭」环节，Annie师傅示范「萝卜饭照烧猪颈肉」。

programme.title: 一条麻甩在汕头粤
programme.desc: 上集于龙眼南路觅食，原来龙眼北路亦不乏非遗美食！祖蓝想开餐，要先执行任务？在食肆自家的农场先抓一只大鹅，祖蓝却称鹅只都与他差不多高，最终只好由老板代劳。精粹的卤水汁如何熬制？祖蓝亦亲身试试卤鹅过程，换来鹅肝、鹅肉、鹅肉丸等满桌美馔。接着到另一非遗食店，先帮手卖出三份肉丸才可品尝大大粒的墨鱼丸，店主还大方公开制作工序。饮啖茶，祖蓝巧遇国家一级潮剧演员，听他浅唱一曲后，祖蓝以京剧回馈对方，同样精彩。

programme.title: 灿烂的外母#15粤
programme.desc: 秀琼认为晓盈破坏司徒岚婚姻，对她恨之入骨。佩珊将晓盈传给威龙的短讯转发秀琼，让她知道百喜升注资鼎福和。秀琼指骂兆明与晓盈夹计吞并鼎福和，坚拒出售家业。窦彰知道司徒岚和兆明为鼎福和吵架，指兆明和秀琼都是为鼎福和好。司徒岚认为窦彰有自主权，窦彰恍然大悟。威龙带晓盈来帮佩珊修理水龙头，佩珊指自己未与威龙离婚，晓盈永远是小三。晓盈得悉邓勤已成功收购冷压果汁五成股权，故谎称鼎福和已落实出售三成股权……

programme.title: 偶像星愿7 Third BEAT!粤日
programme.desc: TRIGGER消失后，相关工作转发给其他偶像，当中不乏有违本身形象的角色。ZOOL上到《爱之Night》做嘉宾，言辞针锋相对，中途放弃表演，刻意制造麻烦。壮五表示想尝试为MEZZO"写歌，希望得到环和其他人的同意。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 本集「Artspiration」，子健哥哥指导Emily姐姐绘画鲸鱼，再加上八爪鱼、水母、海星、珊瑚等海洋生物，以及不同鱼类，构成了一幅生动有趣的海底世界图画。香港向来有美食之都的美誉，食物种类繁多。这回「开心SHARE」以「我最爱的港式食物」为主题，孩子们投稿分享对咖喱鱼蛋、鸡蛋仔、鱼肉烧卖等的喜爱，也勾起主持姐姐对这些美食的滋味回忆，她们更谈到某次于Tiffany姐姐家中共聚BBQ的欢乐时光。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粤日
programme.desc: 在第四次偶像公主大赛中，阿纺展现出光芒四射的公主姿态，引起全城热话。在今天的特备节目中，美月向阳葵、Quartet STAR、千依等人进行采访，尝试找出阿纺那个姿态的原因，可是，阿纺的秘密仍然神秘莫测……

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.title: 利嘉阁地产45 周年真盘源特约：今日有楼睇粤 及 潮流生活志粤
programme.desc: 佐敦一个旧楼单位，由三房改作两房，同时要增大厨房，空间如何分配更合理？

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤

programme.title: 地球大神秘粤
programme.desc: 今年是人类充满惶恐不安的一年，网络上流传不少大灾难的预言：中东战火、日本超级大地震等，我们的明天究竟会怎样呢？很多人想预知未来，研究它的真假，在网络资讯爆炸的时代，越讲越真，越知道反而越惊，就好像圣经一早预言：『人想起将要临到世界的事，就吓得魂不附体』这一刻，站在文明悬崖上的我们，是否正要见证这古老预言成为现实？在全新一辑的地球大神秘，我们会继续从世界各地神秘事件，探讨各种预言的真确，还会同被称为最准确重要的预言书《圣经》作对比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.desc: 经历三年多跌势，楼市在去年终于回稳。根据私人住宅售价指数，楼价在去年3月见底，到今年1月已累计上升约百分之5；全年私楼成交宗数亦创有记绿以来第二高，呈现「价量齐升」的走势。楼市造好，是寒冬内的小阳春抑或长期转向的征兆？过去几年楼价较高位一度下跌近三成，有业主说身家缩水，有中小企指被银行提早收回贷款，但有上车客认为置业负担减轻，各方利益要如何平衡？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粤
programme.desc: 香港特区政府带领各个部门及单位，适时推出不同的政策措施，为本港市民、到访旅客、来自外地的投资者提供便捷服务。香港这么好，当然要多说一些让大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以轻松有趣的拍摄手法，配合陈豪、高海宁、张振朗、刘佩玥、周嘉洛、罗子溢、马国明、陈懿德、陈展鹏、刘颖旋等一众星级艺员，透过不同角色、形象，生动地表达香港的各样美好和优势。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 渣打优先私人理财呈献：Grand住享乐人生粤
programme.desc: 培育下一代是家长一大难题，这集网罗有助孩童身心发展的Grand哲学。儿童马术队成员辛勤训练，与爱驹同步进步，从照顾相处建立人马默契外，还要激励马匹的自信？高Ling试试喂饲马匹，一探骑马益处。品茶学问博大精深，单是「品」字都有得解？茶文化大师传授品茶步骤，并讲述茶艺对塑造性格的正向影响。主持另向专家请教古董普洱茶知识与投资价值。从幼学懂礼仪可提升修养和社交能力，名模陈嘉容指导走路、餐桌的仪态技巧。

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈献:唱钱粤
programme.desc: 音准、拍子大考验，唱歌随时有钱落袋！《声梦传奇2》冠军Jasmine任暟晴接受《唱钱》洗礼，透过挑战Sing盘上不同歌曲难度「过三关」，甚至是最难的Monster关卡，向打爆九宫格的目标进发。观众只需用手机扫描萤幕上的QR Code，即可参与直播室互动，为挑战者打气，更有机会赢取福利。

programme.title: 伯乐音乐学院20周年呈献：J Music粤
programme.desc: 方力申将登红馆开骚，主题为何取名「最佳时间」？小方的个唱举行前，三位女主持潘静文、庄子璇、布子殷率先各自与他合唱！何广沛于剧集《非常检控观》内饰演歌手并发单曲<惩人泪，重拾逾十年前的歌手梦。双鱼座的黎展峰透过<我需要哭抒发情绪，更找来好友为其「一镜到底」的MV执导，却笑言下错决定？杨千嬅完成入行三十周年个唱后，着手筹备推出广东大碟，藉歌曲细诉近几年的人生历程与体会。另会倒数本星期「劲歌金榜」。

programme.title: 风味人间 第2季粤
programme.desc: 酱料能够丰富菜式的味道层次，据说在中国已有两千年历史。喜马拉雅山脉上的藏族人会制作生牦牛肉酱，或许正是东方人最早的酱料食用形态。河南盛产芝麻，可炼制出为食物增香的香油与芝麻酱；北京人涮羊肉时，芝麻酱是标配。以色列人则善用鹰嘴豆泥拌芝麻酱，制成当地的特色食品「胡姆斯」。日本人常以山葵磨成酱，佐吃国民食物鱼生，成为和风饮食代表。香港人吃烧鹅时，总少不了一碟酸梅酱，这种以青梅腌制的酱料更是滋味关键。

programme.title: J Sport粤
programme.desc: 国际柔道锦标赛于启德举行，这集聚焦U21组别战报；U21港将麦静文、刘允乐分别摘下奖牌，并细谈赛场内外的个性反差。沙田苏浙公学致力推动舞蹈、武术，校队分享参与得着，前港将亦忆述校园点滴。中国海帆船赛在维港启航，香港运动员莫俊杰一人兼顾多职，完成单人航海挑战。板网球铜级赛吸引世界级选手来港竞技，助力这运动于本港的发展。青少年棍网球公开赛将上演，港队备战情况如何？国乒名将马龙访港，与年轻球手切磋交流。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤 及 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 财经透视粤
programme.desc: 去年香港玩具出口表现强劲，不少玩具商都会在产品加入科技元素，以提升产品趣味性，情况如何？中东战事令全球投资环境变得不明朗，制定第二季投资策略时要留意甚么？

programme.title: 叠影狙击#11粤PG
programme.desc: 晟杰拿出证据令国栋认罪，蓉蓉被假血白鸽吓到，俊杰指是文雅所为。晓晨猜文雅中毒与俊雄有关，怀疑文雅承认恐吓是受抗胆碱影响。蓉蓉被狗尸体吓到，俊杰被揭患间歇暴怒症遭罢免。高医生自杀，晓晨认出可疑人物是Cat

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 港产旅行团粤PG
programme.desc: 衍峰、淑雅前往长洲，借着踏单车、行山体验离岛之旅。登上全岛最高点北眺亭，俯瞰长洲壮丽景致！Ben Sir亦赶至凑热闹，带队参观浪漫爱情锁墙；吃过平安包，再豪叹隐世鸡煲，香浓锅底回味无穷。祖仪、林正峰随历史专家，胆粗粗开展中西区灵探团，认识本地的都市传说。经典猛鬼之地高街、佐治五世公园，曾传出甚么奇幻事件？淑雅、祖仪再来宅度假，单是网美打卡的奢华浴室，已令她们乐而忘返！两女初试减压颂钵治疗，好疗愈。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粤
programme.desc: 凯婷、凯文均认为，超能力是这集主题「超级英雄」必需的，汛文却提出一个没有超能力但获公认是超级英雄的角色？众谷主讨论超级英雄文化的演变与核心要素，对于超级英雄是否需要遵守法律，看法不尽相同。谷主们分享最爱的超级英雄角色，以及多位超级英雄的代价与弱点，凯婷亦提到某些超级英雄初时会被别人误解，背负沉重压力。她们又觉得超级英雄文化对社会带来不少好处，不仅能产生可观的经济效益，也有助孩子建立正确的价值观。

programme.title: 仨心友行粤
programme.desc: 返回首都吉隆坡，敏之带队前往集写字楼、购物中心、住宅于一身的「生态城」参观，顺道到超市扫货。「睇楼」过后，杨明心痒痒，笑言要马上回港准备置业。敏之、高Ling、凯琳皆有意进军马来西亚做生意，遂向当地女商人取经，了解她由零开始做到坐拥七间鞋店的成功之道。三位美女紧接细看另一住宅项目，逾二千呎的示范单位，设计实用、美观之余，售价亦吸引！肉骨茶是必吃美食，敏之、高Ling用丰富大餐，欢送提早离队的凯琳。

programme.title: 成人教科书粤
programme.desc: 一男一女本地小朋友，分别与一位外籍小孩背对背坐下。大家只透过说话认识对方，对于这种交友模式，众人感受如何？主持洪永城讲出不同的地方，让孩子们说出第一印象，原来不少小朋友都觉得日本人有礼貌。永城接着带两位港孩家访俄罗斯小朋友，并一同享用俄式家常菜，吃后有甚么感想？餐后，众位小朋友换上俄国的节庆服饰，随俄裔男士体验当地传统舞蹈。大家及后还会试玩俄国民间的孩童游戏，这是一款抛掷木棒的竞技，玩法怎样？

programme.title: 手匠传承粤韩
programme.desc: 麻雀是一种中国的传统游戏,是香港人聚会时常玩的游戏 传统的麻雀由工匠亲自雕刻并上色, 每项工序都不容有失 虽然这项工艺已逐渐式微, 但仍然有人为保留它作出努力, 希望传统可以承传下去

programme.title: 翻生工程粤英
programme.desc: 工程师Rob Bell带大家探讨将废弃结构转变为未来建筑背后的重大挑战。

programme.title: 隆行天下之重走八千里路云和月普
粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 打工仔「为钱币做奴隶」的歌词唱出基层心声，谚语「受人二分四」出处亦与钱币有关！几仙「辰砂」随时升值变成价值不菲的古董，收藏家逐一分享私人珍藏。放高利贷人士是否必定「耳窿大」？典当大押在香港曾相当流行，财困客人为何要请当舖掌柜吃「炖蛋」？现代「二叔公」忆述当年闹市「赶绵羊」奇景。主持到访怀旧主题茶餐厅，竟可找到在大型游乐场留下的儿时回忆。今回亦了解顺口又㜺鬼，还蕴藏丰富人生哲理的「念口簧」式民谣。

programme.title: 粤讲粤㜺鬼粤
programme.desc: 狮头紥作师傅巧制威武成品，满足到顾客要求便感高兴，当然不觉自己「狮子捉老鼠－ 大材小用」！「打乞嗤」与被挂念、被咒骂有关？说法竟源于二、三千年前！语言学者钱志安「冇事冇干」翻看粤语长片，原来是为解构五十、六十年代经典地道用语。港人创意无限，汽水盖也可变成开埠早年的儿时恩物，郑宝鸿细说「荷兰水盖」历史。所谓「滚水泡茶－ 又浓又香」，茗茶文化博大精深。何浩文加入主持行列，向茶庄老板请教茶叶加工秘诀。

programme.title: 大玩特玩粤
programme.desc: 主持在马湾寻十只贪玩野兽参与游戏。根据经验，特玩队一定输？杨潮凯认为与翟威廉同组才是真正原因！简单只用派对纸条响哨作游戏，当对手吹响声时用口一咬，阻止对方得分，陈嘉桓要投诉林希灵玩得太恐怖！经典「大电视」游戏出场，为何每条题目都是在形容翟威廉？何浩文见到甚么而变得木无表情？出线游戏「乒乓层层叠」，大玩队在两分钟内便完成，特玩队由威廉接最后一棒，单单是这一棒已花两分钟。看来潮凯的说法不幸言中。

programme.title: 打死不离父子兵粤英
programme.desc: 上阵不离父子兵的毕德利和巴尼再上路探险。今次目标是天气和暖的拉丁美洲。第一站是墨西哥。此程活动包括乘坐热气球升空、和职业摔角手一较高下、观赏一些怪娃娃、并走上挑战极大的登山铁道。

programme.title: 打死不离父子兵粤英
programme.desc: 毕德利和巴尼继续墨西哥之旅。完成艰苦的铁索栈道之后，他们向西南方进发，前去马雅文明发源地尤卡坦半岛。他们去蝙蝠洞观光，希望看到难得一见的蛇吞蝙蝠奇景，又访问太阳剧团，向杂技艺人学习。

programme.title: 星梦频道粤日
programme.desc: 虽然黛雅成功获救，但与此同时，Bug Bug虫却占领了星梦频道卫星，并且让卫星朝著闪亮宿方向坠落。黛雅尝试阻止，却被Bug Bug虫阻挠，无法接近卫星的安全系统，星梦频道偶像能否解救这个危机呢?!

programme.title: 奶龙与小七之大战暴暴龙粤普
programme.desc: 在一个山清水秀的村子里，奶龙小七平静的生活被打破，暴暴龙为了取代奶龙成为宇宙最强龙，在村子各种使坏，奶龙小七为了阻止其的恶行展开一系列英勇斗争，上演了一幕幕只为能守每个人心中最纯真的美好。

programme.title: 奶龙与小七之大战暴暴龙粤普
programme.desc: 在一个山清水秀的村子里，奶龙小七平静的生活被打破，暴暴龙为了取代奶龙成为宇宙最强龙，在村子各种使坏，奶龙小七为了阻止其的恶行展开一系列英勇斗争，上演了一幕幕只为能守每个人心中最纯真的美好。

programme.title: 多啦A梦粤
programme.desc: 是日母亲节，多啦A梦见大雄只是摘了蒲公英送给妈妈，便用「体贴长枪」让妈妈倍感受到关怀。多啦A梦患感冒，多啦美留了药水给他，谁知有人误把「声音凝固剂」当作药水吞服，结果弄得一团乱。

programme.title: B-PROJECT超星团粤日
programme.desc: 开始进行新歌封面设计的14名B-PRO成员各自提出不同想法，让翼整天盯著行程和预算烦恼。Ultras运用一直以来的专长自行创作，在公司里得到很高评价，但好景不常，Ultras在一次直播中竟拍摄到封面草图的档案夹。

programme.title: 魔都女行粤
programme.desc: 主持们再次发掘上海文青小街，来到人气美食集中地愚园路，边尝巨型法式葡挞，边赏令人舒畅的油菜花田，Chill爆。在魔都寻访正宗关东煮，以火龙果蜜桃酒沙瓦伴锅物，味道添上清新。糖妹、娅溦光顾网红小店，红丝绒草莓三文治、芒果巧克力三文治，味蕾有福。必到日式甜品店，多款蛋糕、麻糬入手！特大酥皮手枪鸡腿包，还需集两位主持之力鲸吞咀嚼，份量惊人！夜深，她们还在纪录片体验店开餐，口腹感受满桌「撸串」文化！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 鸡髀菇含有丰富膳食纤维，肥妈以全新方法主理「手撕鸡髀菇」，发挥创意煮出新颖口感滋味。她另采用冬菇、虾仁、鸡肉等食材伴以苦瓜烹调，令口味甘苦的健康食材变得平易近人。南乳的营养价值不容忽视，阿妈将传统「南乳炸鸡翼」加以改良，用油更少吃得更健康。汤水「沙参玉竹螺头炖野鸽」用料十足，清甜可口而且具有养阴清肺功效。此外，6号于今集亦前往食品店见识被称为「梦幻神奇菇」的绣球菌，以及了解不同品种的新鲜玉竹。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 6号外出搜罗枇杷花等中药食材孝敬肥妈，还获鱼档靓姐给予「买一送一」优惠，购入大鱼和鲩鱼的鱼鳔。阿妈炮制一道「姜葱砂锅鱼鳔」，并分享去除鱼鳔腥味的秘诀；另奉上味道浓郁的「枇杷花水鸭紫花果汤」，有助滋阴进补。二人突然上演「厨房剑击」，究竟发生何事？阿妈及后让6号主理「虾干炒蒜心」，他却假手于「自动炒煮机」，还笑言「小学鸡都识煮」！鸡胸肉要炸出脆嫩口感？留意肥妈用蛋白、鱼露等腌制鸡胸，带来「蜜汁鸡球」。

programme.title: 不可能任务粤
programme.desc: 黎诺懿接下挑战任务，要成为「仁济」慈善直播骚监制，梦想有全女班幕后班底，但现实总是充满不可能！一众艺员「转职」幕后，事前对创制不同岗位的认识有几深？趁有其他慈善骚彩排，导演赖慰玲、助导程浩骏、关枫馨深入一厂控制室偷师，及后却认定任务不可能！至于负责撰稿的戴祖仪、李芷晴、梁超怡则到机构辖下设施做资料搜集，没有纸笔记下重点的她们，感觉更像艺人探访。众人于卖桥会议意见多多，却换来节目策划高层皱着眉离开？

programme.title: 不可能任务粤
programme.desc: 卖桥会议后，监制诺懿对团队「黑面」，唯盼大家可切实构思好节目方向。或许对创制岗位未太熟识，众人先上「鸡精班」认清撰稿、助导的日常工作与要求。向仁济一方汇报构思，机构代表听后竟然讲抱歉？这句开场白令诺懿大感压力，幸好最终获赞！「导演」慰玲、「助导」枫馨、「撰稿」芷晴出发进行外景拍摄，到达场地后，枫馨却被摄影师怒视，究竟她犯了甚么「死罪」？拍外景常有突发事，场地代表阻止拍摄，慰玲如何引领团队解决问题？

programme.title: 随懿深度行粤
programme.desc: 怡保「芯」度行启程，黎诺懿相约首集嘉宾李佳芯游二奶巷扫街，还找到数年前与店家的合照？百年药材店转型茶室，两人获老板招待，细味茶文化。木工厂成小朋友乐园，达人手制木造玩具送给大家！佳芯重拾童趣，也意外显露「老灵魂」？坐小船穿过山洞，迎来世外桃源般的镜湖秘景，用心感受大自然的纯粹。佳芯叹白咖啡顺道学拉茶啡，诺懿却弹到二楼「食花生」；咖央多士一啖一牛油，好邪恶！接着深入乡郊的榴梿树屋，享受片刻恬静时光。

programme.title: 随懿深度行粤
programme.desc: 嘉宾刘颖旋初次踏足马来西亚，想疯狂叹美食，却被带到罗京森林……寻找「世界最大之花」大王花，诺懿背起颖旋涉水渡河，说好的悠闲之旅呢？金马仑高原是避暑胜地，颖旋体验喂羊与赶羊，却遭无视？诺懿更被草泥马口水突袭！走进梦幻花海打卡，再DIY微型生态盆栽，好疗愈！豪华营地内的全透明「水晶房」，观星住宿之选。尝过士多啤梨鸡饭后，二人行逛夜市感受地道风情。返回营区继续食，好友围炉自制番薯糖水，回顾旅程深刻点滴。

programme.title: 甜心先生粤
programme.desc: 不论学做甜品还是学习演戏，在名师指导下当然事半功倍。何广沛专诚来向阿古(古嘉俊)拜师，透过学做「柠檬开心果朱古力粒」，领略甜品制作窍门。柠檬汁的酸性会与鲜奶产生化学作用，本来不宜作为朱古力材料，到底阿古有何方法将柠檬芳香融入朱古力？自家制开心果酱不但口味独特，翠缘颜色还令何广沛联想到日式芥辣。原来阿古亦曾以日式芥辣制作甜品，他在节目中分享有趣经验。

programme.title: 新干线战士 改变世界粤日
programme.desc: 太晴因适性值不足未能参战，加上良太和茜的冷言冷语，终于忍不住一走了之。太晴躲进元宇宙之中，讵料伊奈突然出现，更邀请太晴与她一起摧毁超铁机。太晴察觉不妥并拒绝，其后伊奈向超铁机正式宣战。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 扬琴是中国一种传统击弦乐器，演奏时以琴竹敲击琴弦发声，音色清脆悦耳。本集「My Little Show」，一位女生带来扬琴独奏，值得细心聆听。另有六位小女孩手持猪仔钱罂登场，送上充满童趣的芭蕾舞表演。此外，主持姐姐、女结他导师合唱<星星的加冕和<家有小熊两首「童话与梦想之歌」。她们在交流中谈及儿时的勇敢行为与梦想，滢仴姐姐分享自己成功实现成为演员的心愿。

programme.title: 屁屁侦探粤日
programme.desc: 著名设计师黑鹫久美子举办时装表演，惟属于重头戏的公主蛋头冠却离奇消失，屁屁侦探应邀去协助调查，却发现警官数量甚少，原来久美子拒绝报警，屁屁侦探从久美子与模特儿的对话发现案情不单纯。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 小丸子在电视上看到有车轮的行李箱，觉得很新奇，爷爷向英叔借了回来，两人筹备去旅行。姐姐遗失了和良子同学一起造的扣针，遍寻不获，野口教小丸子把失物倒转来念，便有可能把失物寻回。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粤
programme.desc: 香港特区政府带领各个部门及单位，适时推出不同的政策措施，为本港市民、到访旅客、来自外地的投资者提供便捷服务。香港这么好，当然要多说一些让大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以轻松有趣的拍摄手法，配合陈豪、高海宁、张振朗、刘佩玥、周嘉洛、罗子溢、马国明、陈懿德、陈展鹏、刘颖旋等一众星级艺员，透过不同角色、形象，生动地表达香港的各样美好和优势。

programme.title: 危机现场粤
programme.desc: 本片选取近年来国内最具代表性的安全事故和自然灾害，作科学分析，重现处置过程，展现当下中国应急救援专业能力的提升和全新面貌，分析事发原因和调查过程，解读事故隐患。同时，展示人类的勇气、智慧与无畏。

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤
星期日档案粤
programme.desc: 近年香港的士行业迎来「新血」，运输署资料显示，截至2025年10月，40岁或以下持牌司机增加至182万人，较2019年显著上升五成四。这群年轻司机，大多追求弹性工时，以及多劳多得的收入结构。当中部分人组成车队，透过社交媒体，积极开拓新市场；也有人成为「的士打理人」，承担十多部的士的管理责任。他们会为行业带来甚么新气象？在过程中，又会面对甚么困难？

programme.title: 警声百二秒 III粤
programme.desc: 「警声百二秒」系列再次归来，《警声百二秒 III》由警方代表联同众多艺员参与演出，会继续透过有趣的故事情节，介绍香港警务处更多部门的工作、更多防罪讯息，让广大市民可轻松「全方位」了解警队更多资讯。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 香港何济公止痛退热散呈献：中年好声音4粤
programme.desc: 「黑白荣耀换位赛」，翻出第二章。上一集，「上弦黑队」全员成功守住宝座，本集五回对决中，「下弦白队」可会有人能够「反Cup」？而掉进「危险区」的五位选手，究竟哪两人即将告别「中4」舞台？

programme.title: 一周星星粤
programme.desc: 游戏节目《唱钱》引来网络热话，主持兼音乐总监Eric Kwok更为相关评分系统付出极大心力！太太叶佩雯于「你问我答」拍片提问，想知Eric突然不怕蟑螂的原因。说起太太，《唱钱》另一主持森美当年瞒婚，为何近年不介意多谈家庭事？身边朋友常听森美提到会退休，究竟几时才退？另外，对于被指在作曲方面江郎才尽，Eric坦言对作曲的兴趣有所减退，其中一个原因是多了XiX经理人的身分，还自揭并非主动提出要任此职！

programme.title: 美食新闻周报粤
programme.desc: 行仔与鼎爷到访星厨主理的私房菜馆，品尝以法式吊汤方式烹调的羊肚菌清鸡汤、内藏「佛跳墙」的炸子鸡，极富心思。居港瑞士厨师带晖哥享用正宗瑞士菜，包括传统芝士火锅、苏黎世式牛仔肉等佳肴，并细说瑞士饮食文化。行仔再与伍倩彤到大澳「扫街」，遍尝即炸沙翁、虾酱猪肉卷饼、炭烧黄花鱼春及濑尿虾干，别具风味。尖沙咀一间24小时营业的食店，复刻昔日车仔档的沙嗲风味，烧鸭丝沙嗲米通粉、沙嗲小食拼盘，皆是宵夜好选择。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 农本方参苓白术散呈献:天气报告粤
叠影狙击#12粤PG
programme.desc: 忠仔突然身亡，晟杰让晓晨向Green World成员套话，Tina向晓晨承认他们在工地的水泥袋里发现很多钱，怀疑新领域集团走私黑钱。忠仔因缺钱，半夜到工地偷钱，极可能因此遇害。文诺看到忠仔的新闻，安排霆钊进行下一步行动。

programme.title: 东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 约埋班Friend去旅行粤PG
programme.desc: 亲近动物有不少方法，这趟旅程会多角度展示。从小已怕动物的慰玲猜拳输了要喂羊驼，竟被牠吓至跌倒，还惊到喊。朱仔首次骑马后，形容似「坐过山车」，一边骑马，一边亦可欣赏户外骏域谷的美景。主持们还乘坐马车游览，振朗却差点被抛出车外。深入远离悉尼市区的猎人谷，先到百年历史的酒窖品酒，加上朱古力Pairing就更出众？其后，三位好友安躺草地看日落，细谈「浪漫的定义」。而慰玲心目中的浪漫，竟只是一句话这般简单？

programme.title: 约埋班Friend去旅行粤PG
programme.desc: 继续畅游猎人谷，主持们在户外学造朱古力；朱仔尝试追女仔惨「食柠檬」，只好向男拍档出手？玩电动平衡车时，振朗被慰玲「嫌废」。在邦迪海滩开心踏浪，怎料众人最终湿身收场！清晨五时，大家划独木舟出海看日出。「咸蛋黄」初升之际，画面却令幕后人员崩溃，究竟发生何事？振朗及后更模仿蔡思贝发声控诉？在酒吧喝着鸡尾酒聚话，节目组准备了情感问题，让三人来一趟深情对话。当要向身旁好友说出心底话，振朗、慰玲更双双落泪……

programme.title: 甜心先生粤
programme.desc: 不论学做甜品还是学习演戏，在名师指导下当然事半功倍。何广沛专诚来向阿古(古嘉俊)拜师，透过学做「柠檬开心果朱古力粒」，领略甜品制作窍门。柠檬汁的酸性会与鲜奶产生化学作用，本来不宜作为朱古力材料，到底阿古有何方法将柠檬芳香融入朱古力？自家制开心果酱不但口味独特，翠缘颜色还令何广沛联想到日式芥辣。原来阿古亦曾以日式芥辣制作甜品，他在节目中分享有趣经验。

programme.title: 魔都女行粤
programme.desc: 转转口味，糖妹、娅溦这集来到上海的韩国街，化身「韩妹」遍寻韩式小吃。快餐车直送芝士香肠热狗、奶油年糕汤。未够滋味？帮衬出炉热辣辣核桃饼与咖啡豆饼。炭烧烤肉风味大餐开动！厚切猪五花棒棒糖、猪猪星球拼盘，还不及火豚星三拼饭邪恶！大口吞下韩国的味道，难怪娅溦要点喝清肠排毒果汁。主持们换上汉服，置身格调优雅的文化茶馆，在城市中的世外桃源歇一歇息。入夜，全力冲刺全蟹宴私房菜，娅溦带来独门拌蟹面吃法！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 鸡髀菇含有丰富膳食纤维，肥妈以全新方法主理「手撕鸡髀菇」，发挥创意煮出新颖口感滋味。她另采用冬菇、虾仁、鸡肉等食材伴以苦瓜烹调，令口味甘苦的健康食材变得平易近人。南乳的营养价值不容忽视，阿妈将传统「南乳炸鸡翼」加以改良，用油更少吃得更健康。汤水「沙参玉竹螺头炖野鸽」用料十足，清甜可口而且具有养阴清肺功效。此外，6号于今集亦前往食品店见识被称为「梦幻神奇菇」的绣球菌，以及了解不同品种的新鲜玉竹。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粤
programme.desc: 6号外出搜罗枇杷花等中药食材孝敬肥妈，还获鱼档靓姐给予「买一送一」优惠，购入大鱼和鲩鱼的鱼鳔。阿妈炮制一道「姜葱砂锅鱼鳔」，并分享去除鱼鳔腥味的秘诀；另奉上味道浓郁的「枇杷花水鸭紫花果汤」，有助滋阴进补。二人突然上演「厨房剑击」，究竟发生何事？阿妈及后让6号主理「虾干炒蒜心」，他却假手于「自动炒煮机」，还笑言「小学鸡都识煮」！鸡胸肉要炸出脆嫩口感？留意肥妈用蛋白、鱼露等腌制鸡胸，带来「蜜汁鸡球」。

programme.title: 打死不离父子兵粤英
programme.desc: 上阵不离父子兵的毕德利和巴尼再上路探险。今次目标是天气和暖的拉丁美洲。第一站是墨西哥。此程活动包括乘坐热气球升空、和职业摔角手一较高下、观赏一些怪娃娃、并走上挑战极大的登山铁道。

programme.title: 打死不离父子兵粤英
programme.desc: 毕德利和巴尼继续墨西哥之旅。完成艰苦的铁索栈道之后，他们向西南方进发，前去马雅文明发源地尤卡坦半岛。他们去蝙蝠洞观光，希望看到难得一见的蛇吞蝙蝠奇景，又访问太阳剧团，向杂技艺人学习。

programme.title: CI alk 国际直球对决(首)
CI alk 国际直球对决(首)
异想天开木瓜岛
programme.desc: 欢迎来到木瓜岛！这是一个与世隔绝的地方，有著独特又古怪的传统，木瓜岛的每个孩子都有小牛看护者，除了一个不知怎么来到岛上的孩子－－卡库佩，经过种种努力，终于得到一只神经质的小牛苏格拉底。而这对特别的搭档，将会挑战木瓜岛的传统……

programme.desc: 【韩国收视破38%韩版《真善美》重拾幸福时光】《我唯一的守护者》编剧金始庆最新家庭剧新作，与爸爸、继母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因继兄继母闯祸被诈骗，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面对爸爸的偏坦对待，朴丹丹愤而离家，因缘际会下来到有钱人家担任住宿教师，陪伴失去母亲的三个孩子，而他们的爸爸便是高冷霸道总裁李英国，在妻子早逝后，英国的内心渐渐封闭，与孩子间也产生隔阂，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出现，加上孩子们的凑合，幸福将再次降临。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【离家追梦，还是回家团圆？冯家菜北漂生存战】冯家菜是北京颇具名气的淮扬菜馆，女强人大米凭借一身拼劲，将小馆打造成金字招牌，却因妹夫欠债，陷入食品安全风波，生意一落千丈。为救餐馆，她请出退休父亲参赛，夺得全国冠军，却招来资本大鳄周路的觊觎。亲情与利益交织，事业与爱情碰撞，兄妹间信任破裂，冯家菜面临生死存亡。当大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子终于悔悟，全家携手重建家业。当扬州炒饭再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改变。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金马演员携手演出破产母女生存记】少见的审计职场剧，乐观正向，带给人心激励。从小在拮据家庭成长的邱冬娜，在课业工作上总是特别勤奋，希望透过自己的努力让母亲过上好生活。毕业后，因缘际会下进入了前辈顾飞开的审计稽核公司，面对孤僻但能力强的主管顾飞，邱冬娜虽然头痛但绝不认输！运用从母亲身上学到的智慧，还有艰困生活带给她的精打细算体质，邱冬娜总能屡出奇招化解艰难任务。曾有心理创伤的主管顾飞，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，两人亦师亦友,相互扶持鼓励，逐渐治愈伤口，成为彼此的灵魂伴侣。

programme.title: 两个女人的房间(完)
programme.desc: 【惨遭闺蜜心机暗算朴恩惠由饭店继承人沦为女仆】在瑞士留学归来后，晴彩充满自信地踏入了蒙娜丽莎饭店，端庄秀丽的外表和聪颖的头脑，让她很快成为了饭店的副社长兼继承人。与同饭店的总经理志燮之间的恋情，更是让她的生活充满了甜蜜和期待。一场车祸意外将掀起腥风血雨，当晴彩以为自己撞死了熙秀的养父时，内心充满了恐惧与内疚感，在晴彩的坚持下，熙秀搬进了她的家，开始了新的生活。从那时起，晴彩心爱的人和她的一切都逐渐被熙秀所夺走，包括饭店的地位和财富，晴彩更是从继承人沦为女仆，为了夺回曾经的一切，晴彩将对熙秀展开复仇。

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 我的野蛮王妃
programme.desc: 【神级经典韩剧，尹恩惠、朱智勋、金桢勋、宋智孝再现现代宫廷指腹为婚！！】申采静原本只是一名平凡无奇的高中学生，得知爷爷的遗嘱中，她与皇太子李信有婚约在身。因家中债务的原因，在无可奈何的情况完婚。待在皇室的申采静对宫内生活十分反弹，此时海归回来的皇位第二继承者李律及李信前女友闵孝琳的存在，展开错综复杂的故事。

programme.title: 另一种蓝
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事业失意返乡传承青花瓷再现风华！！】北漂少女陈小满努力工作、省吃俭用为求入股家族瓷器事业，却以失败收场，毅然决然回景德镇专心学习瓷器工艺。陈小满工作的上司柯岩则在投资上遭遇前所未有的失利，辗转来到景德镇。处于低潮的两人在互相治愈中重新找回站起来的力量，事业重新起步，爱情也开始萌芽。

programme.title: 装腔启示录
programme.desc: 初级律师唐影在上海红圈律所工作，意外结识了合作方许子诠。虽然二人暗生情愫，却始终没有勇气直面真实的情感。两人历经多次事件，最终在唐影的帮助下，许子诠驱散了多年阴影，敢于直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在许子诠的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真实的一面。

programme.title: 六龙飞天
programme.desc: 李成桂为了正式的投身政治启程去往开京，李芳远也跟随着父亲去了开京。来到开京的李芳远看到了置百姓死活于不顾只为自己填饱肚子的权文势族，无法抑制住自己内心的愤怒。原本就对于李成桂的政界出仕很警惕的李仁谦将李成桂邀请到自己家里并举办了宴会，在宴会上李仁谦给他看了以他背叛了曾经像兄弟一样的赵小生为题材的街头剧。在宴会结束后李成桂为了让李仁谦保守自己背叛赵末生的秘密，向李仁谦低下了头，李芳远目击到了这一幕。

programme.desc: 【电影《原本以为只是手机掉了》任时完，大反派变小可怜少年，勇往直前成为校园新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生张秉泰，以「在学校不挨打」为最大目标。某天因父亲意外的关系，连夜逃到隔壁村，转学至扶余农高竟摇身一变成为学校老大，亲身体验强者生存的热血故事。

programme.title: 绅士与小姐
programme.desc: 【韩国收视破38%韩版《真善美》重拾幸福时光】《我唯一的守护者》编剧金始庆最新家庭剧新作，与爸爸、继母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因继兄继母闯祸被诈骗，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面对爸爸的偏坦对待，朴丹丹愤而离家，因缘际会下来到有钱人家担任住宿教师，陪伴失去母亲的三个孩子，而他们的爸爸便是高冷霸道总裁李英国，在妻子早逝后，英国的内心渐渐封闭，与孩子间也产生隔阂，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出现，加上孩子们的凑合，幸福将再次降临。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【离家追梦，还是回家团圆？冯家菜北漂生存战】冯家菜是北京颇具名气的淮扬菜馆，女强人大米凭借一身拼劲，将小馆打造成金字招牌，却因妹夫欠债，陷入食品安全风波，生意一落千丈。为救餐馆，她请出退休父亲参赛，夺得全国冠军，却招来资本大鳄周路的觊觎。亲情与利益交织，事业与爱情碰撞，兄妹间信任破裂，冯家菜面临生死存亡。当大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子终于悔悟，全家携手重建家业。当扬州炒饭再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改变。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金马演员携手演出破产母女生存记】少见的审计职场剧，乐观正向，带给人心激励。从小在拮据家庭成长的邱冬娜，在课业工作上总是特别勤奋，希望透过自己的努力让母亲过上好生活。毕业后，因缘际会下进入了前辈顾飞开的审计稽核公司，面对孤僻但能力强的主管顾飞，邱冬娜虽然头痛但绝不认输！运用从母亲身上学到的智慧，还有艰困生活带给她的精打细算体质，邱冬娜总能屡出奇招化解艰难任务。曾有心理创伤的主管顾飞，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，两人亦师亦友,相互扶持鼓励，逐渐治愈伤口，成为彼此的灵魂伴侣。

programme.title: 绝妙的遗产
programme.desc: 【拒分遗产！为教训贪财不孝子老父亲再婚年轻单亲妈】80岁的老板夫英培，经营50年历史的平壤冷面老店，在一次睡梦中偶然灵魂出窍，4名儿子误以为父亲死亡，正在房外讨论著如何分配爸爸的遗产。看著这些不成材的儿子们只想著财产，令夫英培非常痛心，醒来后打算将财产全数捐出，不料遭到基金会拒收。在一次偶然事件中，与30岁的单亲妈妈孔桂玉相遇，并打算在儿子面前上演假结婚，当桂玉正式成为继母后，儿子们慌了手脚，经过朝夕相处后，一家人克服了偏见，儿子们也不再觊觎遗产，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 我的野蛮王妃
programme.desc: 【神级经典韩剧，尹恩惠、朱智勋、金桢勋、宋智孝再现现代宫廷指腹为婚！！】申采静原本只是一名平凡无奇的高中学生，得知爷爷的遗嘱中，她与皇太子李信有婚约在身。因家中债务的原因，在无可奈何的情况完婚。待在皇室的申采静对宫内生活十分反弹，此时海归回来的皇位第二继承者李律及李信前女友闵孝琳的存在，展开错综复杂的故事。

programme.title: 另一种蓝
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事业失意返乡传承青花瓷再现风华！！】北漂少女陈小满努力工作、省吃俭用为求入股家族瓷器事业，却以失败收场，毅然决然回景德镇专心学习瓷器工艺。陈小满工作的上司柯岩则在投资上遭遇前所未有的失利，辗转来到景德镇。处于低潮的两人在互相治愈中重新找回站起来的力量，事业重新起步，爱情也开始萌芽。

programme.title: 装腔启示录
programme.desc: 初级律师唐影在上海红圈律所工作，意外结识了合作方许子诠。虽然二人暗生情愫，却始终没有勇气直面真实的情感。两人历经多次事件，最终在唐影的帮助下，许子诠驱散了多年阴影，敢于直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在许子诠的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真实的一面。

programme.title: 六龙飞天
programme.desc: 李成桂为了正式的投身政治启程去往开京，李芳远也跟随着父亲去了开京。来到开京的李芳远看到了置百姓死活于不顾只为自己填饱肚子的权文势族，无法抑制住自己内心的愤怒。原本就对于李成桂的政界出仕很警惕的李仁谦将李成桂邀请到自己家里并举办了宴会，在宴会上李仁谦给他看了以他背叛了曾经像兄弟一样的赵小生为题材的街头剧。在宴会结束后李成桂为了让李仁谦保守自己背叛赵末生的秘密，向李仁谦低下了头，李芳远目击到了这一幕。

programme.title: 少年时代
programme.desc: 【电影《原本以为只是手机掉了》任时完，大反派变小可怜少年，勇往直前成为校园新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生张秉泰，以「在学校不挨打」为最大目标。某天因父亲意外的关系，连夜逃到隔壁村，转学至扶余农高竟摇身一变成为学校老大，亲身体验强者生存的热血故事。

programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want to play restaurants with Grandad, but it's a little different than he's used to... he's going to need an app to order the food!

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - This Way, That Way
programme.desc: The Teletubbies go 'this way, that way' on a Tubby Car journey to the Hidey Hup. The Tubby Spinny goes 'this way, that way' too.

programme.title: Teletubbies Ready Steady Go! (S1) - Hello, Hello (Eh-Oh!)
programme.desc: Join the dance party with the Teletubbies! Tinky Winky, Dipsy, Laa-Laa and Po dance and sing and say "Hello".

programme.title: Pop Paper City (S1) - Planet Pop Beam
programme.desc: The friends travel into outer space to visit Planet Popbeam. Mae-Mae wonders if the planet is made of cheese, but Phoebe thinks it's made of rock.

programme.title: Dog Loves Books (S1) - Dog Loves Diggers
programme.desc: Dog and Pug are on a building site and they meet three Diggers - Big Digger, Bigger Digger and Tiny. The two big diggers look down on Tiny but she is the one who wants to do all the work.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S1) - Paperchase
programme.desc: Messy, a monster, explores science questions that children ask about the world around us. Messy has a pair of yummy green socks waiting for him. He eats one, but where is the second? He visits OKIDO to find out.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO (S1) - Lolly's Keys
programme.desc: Messy monster is having breakfast and sees little objects on the fridge. Why don't they fall off? He goes to OKIDO to find out!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops (S1) - Pirate Parade
programme.desc: Mojo and Bo fix Ted up as a pirate ship for the Pirate Parade, but swashbuckling Cap'n Dot hijacks him! Team Mojo must out-pirate Dot and sail the streets to stop her.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S1) - It's time to dance
programme.desc: Gran Gran busts a groove when she teaches JoJo the moves to a traditional Saint Lucian dance. JoJo finds that learning a dance can take time, before realising she can put her own twist on it.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S1) - It's time to look at old pictures
programme.desc: A photo of Gran Gran and JoJo's mummy when she was a little girl inspires them to take a walk and compare old photos of their neighbourhood to see how it has changed over time.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Mars As Moon
programme.desc: Mars tries to fill in for a missing Moon, but needs a little coaching from Sarah &amp; Duck.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck (S3) - Donkey Jump
programme.desc: Sarah &amp; Duck try to help Donkey get his jumping confidence back by building a surprise for him in their back garden.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends (S24) - World of Tomorrow
programme.desc: When a pair of crooks steal plans for a great new invention, there is a high-speed chase to try and get them back and allow them to prove their worth.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Yoga Ball
programme.desc: Bingo loves playing with Dad, but sometimes he forgets Bingo is smaller than her sister. Mum teaches Bingo how to use her big girl bark to keep the fun within her limits.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - Calypso
programme.desc: At school, Bluey and her friends enjoy various games. Teacher Calypso keeps her charges on track with a wise word and a song... all except the mysterious Pretzel.

programme.title: Bluey (S1) - The Doctor
programme.desc: Honey is stuck waiting for Dr Bingo's as the other injuries get seen before her. Receptionist Bluey tells her to be patient, some of these cases are a real pickle!

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Treasure In The Plant Aisle
programme.desc: In the perilous plant aisle Supertato and Evil Pea team up to find treasure as they have half a map each, but she tricks him and steals the map to find the treasure for herself.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - Roly's First Day
programme.desc: As Roly makes his usual noise in the Clubhouse, Duggee and the Squirrels reminisce about how completely different Roly was when he first arrived.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S4) - The Spot the Difference Badge
programme.desc: Duggee looks different, but what is it? By playing some looking games, the Squirrels learn how best to spot the difference.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Squirrel Babies
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Machu Picchu, Peru
programme.desc: A giant grimbot bounces down the valley of Machu Picchu. Can the Go Jetters stop him?

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Avenue of the Baobabs, Madagascar
programme.desc: GrimHQ crashes into the Baobab trees. Can the Go Jetters rescue a baby lemur in time?

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Venice, Italy
programme.desc: The Go Jetters get a sinking feeling when Glitch turns the canals of Venice into roads.

programme.title: My World Kitchen (S1) - Charlotte's Irish Boxty
programme.desc: Charlotte makes an Irish boxty for her friends. She uses mashed and grated potatoes to make her boxty and tops it with a cooked egg. She hopes her friends will really like it.

programme.title: Andy's Baby Animal Missions (S1) - Andy and the Black Bear Cubs
programme.desc: In this episode, Andy, Jen and Scout head to Alaska, America on a baby animal mission to help rescue some black bear cubs high up in a tree. Along the way, Andy meets a grumpy Arctic ground squirrel.

programme.title: Swashbuckle (S7) - Captain Captain's Back
programme.desc: In this episode Captain Captain returns to her beloved Scarlet Squid (much to the surprise of Gem) and has brought along two brand new pirates, Sandy and Seaweed, to help win those jewels back.

programme.title: Panda and Krash (S1) - Lilly is Ill
programme.desc: Lily is telling everyone the story about an orange kitten and spotted cat fishing.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Featherwand
programme.desc: Bluey and Mum are off to Chloe's party and Bingo isn't invited. But armed with a magic featherwand that makes things incredibly heavy, Bingo can now stop them leaving the house.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Squash
programme.desc: When dad and Uncle Stripe play a game of squash, Bluey and Bingo are in control of their every move, and Bingo proves that big siblings don't always beat little siblings.

programme.title: Bluey (S2) - Hairdressers
programme.desc: During a game of hairdressers, Bluey discovers that big-headed customer Dad has nits! To help treat them Bingo has to find her voice, while Bluey has to find her ears.

programme.title: Supertato (S2) - Ahoy Captain Pak Choi
programme.desc: Supertato and Broccoli go on a pirate adventure with Captain Pak Choi, but they don't realise she intends on plundering Evil Pea's freezer and stealing all her shiny things.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Didgeridoo
programme.desc: Tinky Winky learns to play the didgeridoo. The Teletubbies do a special didgeridoo Tubby Phone Dance. Tiddlytubby Ping loves the didgeridoo too!

programme.title: Yakka Dee (S3) - Rocket
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say 'rocket' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure

programme.desc: Zim and Zam have discovered the lost city of Micro OKIDO.

programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo teach Unicorse good manners so he can ask Mum on a date, but things go awry when Unicorse eats a tick.

programme.desc: Indy thinks she's no good because her model horse looks like a cow, but Calypso encourages her not to give up, so she tries to fix it with a little help from Winton.

programme.desc: Seamus has booked the wrong date for his and Little Woo's holiday. Stanley repurposes the locations of the town into activities and sights to give them a holiday in a day.

programme.title: Stan Can (S1) - Dig
programme.desc: Stanley helps Fifi and Fred dig up some shiny stones in their garden that turn out to be old bits of mosaic. With the help of Cynthia and Hettie, they put the pieces back together.

programme.title: Number 1 Newton Avenue (S1) - The Puppet Show
programme.desc: Jayden is listening to Papa read a story about 'Anansi the Spider'. He likes it so much, that he wants to make an Anansi Spider himself.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran (S3) - It's Time for a Surprise
programme.desc: JoJo, Gran Gran and Panda are helping Cynthia in her garden - JoJo loves how tall the sunflowers are. Cynthia gives JoJo a present of some sunflower seeds - JoJo can keep them ready to plant and grow more sunflowers next year.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Faceytalk
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love to video chat with Muffin and Socks so they can all draw pictures together. When Muffin won't give Socks a turn, the kids discover what happens when you hog.

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Ragdoll
programme.desc: Dad agrees to take Bluey and Bingo to the shops to buy an ice-cream if they can get him into the car. Only problem is... he's just entered 'Ragdoll' mode!

programme.title: Bluey (S3) - Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Dad tells Bluey and Bingo a real-life fairy tale about growing up in a wild place called the '80s, about a boy who was cursed when he was mean to his little brother.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Colour Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is painting in his favourite colouring book. The Squirrels want to have a go too.

programme.title: Hey Duggee (S2) - The Harvest Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is getting ready to harvest the ripe crops that grown. The squirrels remember when they planted their seeds, watered them, and left them to grow, and now it's time to help Duggee pick them all.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club (S1) - Squirrel Babies
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with.

programme.title: Go Jetters (S2) - Bird Migration: Spain & Africa
programme.desc: In this aerial adventure the Go Jetters are on the Strait of Gibraltar, Southern Spain to follow a group of migrating baby stalks as they make their journey from Spain to Africa.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Lemon
programme.desc: Lemon performs a stand-up routine!

programme.title: Roots & Fruits (S1) - Carrot
programme.desc: Carrot sings about being trendy.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Grape Kids' Super Camp
programme.desc: Supertato shows the Grape Kids how to camp Supertato-style, but Evil Pea arrives and wows them with her ice camping. Before long, the Grape Kids need to be rescued by Supertato.

programme.title: Supertato (S1) - Operation Kiwi
programme.desc: Supertato, Carrot and Tomato are exploring in the plant aisle when they hear a strange noise. They follow the noise and meet the famous Kiwi the Explorer, who needs their help.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Didgeridoo
programme.desc: Tinky Winky learns to play the didgeridoo. The Teletubbies do a special didgeridoo Tubby Phone Dance. Tiddlytubby Ping loves the didgeridoo too!

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: A crippled woman seeks vengeance against the four men who killed her parents. However, when she crosses path with a young warrior who falls in love with her, trouble ensues as his father is one of the killers responsible for her family's massacre years ago.

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: Call to Arms
programme.desc: The aggressive and dangerous Chin Empire conquers the hard-put Chao kingdom while the Wei empire is drained of its heroes and paralyzed by an indecisive ruler. Adventure, intrigue, death and tragedy reigns before the triumphant clash of the armies.

programme.title: Tales of a Eunuch
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao enters the palace and unexpectedly befriends Emperor Kang Xi. At the same time, he is assigned by a revolutionary group to steal the valuable "Sutra of 42 Chapters," which Emperor Kang Xi himself is also seeking. Demonstrating keen intelligence, Xiao Bao deftly navigates between opposing factions and successfully evades danger.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend "Investiture of the Gods", this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: After a notorious rapist Xiao kills his master and the entire clan, Han the last surviving disciple, decides to take revenge. He must find the legendary Hulong Blade to counter Xiao's Evil Poisonous Sword, but as Han has never seen Xiao before, he is deceived when Xiao poses as an ally to try and steal his Blade in the process.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her...

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black
programme.desc: Set during the Japanese occupation in World War II, a young orphan Tang Qi falls in a love with a young man Chang. However, their love is filled with challenges, from family pressure to the turmoil of war. When Tang Qi was raped, she is expelled from home to become a nightclub singer and embarks on a journey of no return...

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies...

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: When Qiao Miao is about to kill the bandit whom he just met, he is attracted by her beauty and they quickly fall in love. The two later discover the blood feud between the owner of the unique weapon - "Twelve Deadly Coins" and the old master who controls the bandit...

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: A Place to Call Home
programme.desc: Li Ching, star of Sweet is Revenge, plays one of three daughters, whose life is turned upside down when she discovers she is adopted. But things get even worse when she goes in search of her real mother. Finally, after what is almost a double tragedy, she realizes what so many knew all along: There's no place like home.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: A dying master dispatches his last pupil to track down five ex-students who are each an expert in his own lethal combat style. He fears they will steal the fortune belonging to their clan and tasks his pupil to prevent their attempt.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan's disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score "The Proud One". Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan's leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says "I do"?

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: Legend of the Bat
programme.desc: It is rumoured that people can buy anything they desire on the mysterious Island of Bats so long as they have money. The charismatic swordsman Chu Liu Xiang and his friend travel to the island to seek answers but realize they are not the only ones who want to unveil the mystery of this place.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: A 17-year old schoolgirl marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when they attempt to keep their relationship a secret despite being in the same school. When they discover unwanted suitors going after their other halves, jealousy threatens to expose their marriage any minute!

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Big Brother Cheng fled from the mainland to Hong Kong, where he opened a teahouse in a housing estate, hoping to find a peaceful life. However, relentless provocations from local triad gangs go unaddressed by the police, prompting Cheng and his friends at the teahouse to seek revenge.

programme.title: The Tea House
programme.desc: Big Brother Cheng fled from the mainland to Hong Kong, where he opened a teahouse in a housing estate, hoping to find a peaceful life. However, relentless provocations from local triad gangs go unaddressed by the police, prompting Cheng and his friends at the teahouse to seek revenge.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: This is a martial arts epic directed by Chang Cheh. In the Sung Dynasty, the government is run by corrupt officials, so Sung Jiang gathers 108 outlaws at Mount Liang and establishes a band of patriotic heroes to end the repression of brutal overlords.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer (Li Ching), the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: The Ming Emperor is dying with no heir to succeed the throne. His brother recalls that he has an illegitimate child with a court lady years ago and palace guards are sent to search for the heir. When the Emperor's nephew hires assassins to kill the child so he can be the successor, the Swift Knight comes to the rescue...

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend's baby...

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu's son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong's three daughters. Eventually, Gan's daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him...

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resisting the Mongolian invasion of their homeland. Will Marco Polo stay loyal to the emperor?

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A Wu Dang disciple Fu, kills the chief of Wu Dang Clan and frames it on the chief's illegitimate child, Yun. Fu then proclaims himself the new chief and orders the killing of Yun, who vows to avenge his father's death and learns the invincible silkworm martial arts style in order to defeat Fu.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master who left the martial arts world to protect his lover. However, his disappearance leads to her tragic death and as Liang Kun finds a way to survive in the martial arts world, he fights back to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn...

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Iceman the Time Traveler
programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Girl with the Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: An aspiring TV actress gets into hot water when a stolen diamond is hidden in the shoes she bought for a party.

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll's eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Open the Coffin
programme.desc: Ghost Hand and his tomb raiders resurface in Jiang City to seek gold in ancient tombs after a 3-year absence. They released an evil spirit from a coffin and all four died at home eventually. Poison and pinholes in the corpses become the sole clue for police investigation. A tomb raid now unfolds as a perplexing and mysterious case.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory. While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kong's Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Operation Bangkok
programme.desc: Military veteran Wu and undercover cop Ming rescue hostages on an island near Bangkok. Just as the mission is completed and they prepare to leave, Wu discovers his daughter has also been captured. Determined to save her, he stays with Ming to fight the thugs and rescue her.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Fight Back to School III
programme.desc: When millionaire Wong is found murdered in a hotel room, Sing, who bears a striking resemblance to the victim, goes undercover as the deceased to investigate the case. With Wong's marriage already on the rocks, his wife becomes the prime suspect. However, Sing soon uncovers that Wong's close friend is suspicious as well...

programme.title: The Sorcerer &amp; The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor's eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: So was born a nobleman but is relegated to a beggar after being caught cheating. He becomes the chief of the Beggar's gang when he saves the gang's elder. One day, So foils an assassination attempt on the Emperor and is allowed to reinstate his status but he declines. He is then rewarded with an imperial beggar bowl and lives happily ever after.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.
